notes: Trigger-coverage eval suite recorded BEFORE the v1.18.0 description rewrite, so the rewrite has a baseline to be measured against. Positives are natural-language prompts a user would really type; every one was written from the skill's BODY with the frontmatter unopened, and any positive sharing a four-word run with the current description was rejected -- a prompt written from the description measures whether the words survived, not whether the trigger did. Negatives are lifted from SIBLING skills a wrong pick would land on, so the score measures separation from close neighbours rather than recall. Word-overlap scoring is blind to trigger-condition NARROWING -- run check_skill_descriptions.py --compare for that.
